name: 46838-longprefill-8x7b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole node, exclusively, no cross-node fabric.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, expert parallelism off, V1 engine core, one in-process vLLM engine; every GPU holds a slice of every expert.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 16 streams, bounded at 300 requests with a 1200 s safety cap, 10% warmup and 10% cooldown declared. Read the scored population off `request_latency.successful.count`; it is not exactly (1-p)N.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, 4096 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens, FIXED (min = max = mean, so every request is identical), no prefix buckets, prefill-dominated by design. The backend renders through the chat template and sets ignore_eos, so the engine tokenizes a few tokens more than 4096, reports its own count, and runs every generation to the full 512.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a mixture-of-experts model, serving 16 concurrent users four-thousand-token prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
model: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1
tensor-parallel-size: 8
moe-backend: flashinfer_cutlass
max-model-len: 16384
max-num-seqs: 16
dtype: bfloat16
# HAZARD: this value must stay on ONE line. The file is read line by line and indented lines are
# skipped, so re-flowing it into a block mapping drops the key and the engine starts without it.
compilation-config: {"compile_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8], "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_AND_PIECEWISE", "pass_config": {"fuse_allreduce_rms": false}}
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
